reason: For isotropic binary linear tasks, direct rewrite to the new separator retains agreement 1-acos(overlap)/pi with the old task. At overlap=0.99 this is about 0.955, already above the frozen 0.95 retention threshold, so REPLAY need not be frontier-optimal. At overlap=0.98 direct rewrite agreement is about 0.936 (<0.95), while a midpoint shared separator is about 0.968 agreement with each task, creating the intended replay-admissible / rewrite-inadmissible regime.
